meta.title: No credit union in Superior
meta.description: Superior has no operating credit union branch. Arizona Copper FCU (Kearny-based, founded 1955) had a branch at 161 W Main St; it merged into American Southwest CU in 2024-25 and ASCU's branch list no longer includes Superior (closure date unconfirmed — call (520) 459-1860). Nearest open branches: Kearny (~20 mi straight-line), Florence (~24 mi), Apache Junction (~27 mi). The shaded circle is a 19-mile radius around Superior with no credit union in it. Gray markers are credit union branches and 🌾 farm lenders — every popup lists what that lender makes loans for. No credit union here advertises land-only, farm or co-op lending. Co-op lenders with no Arizona office (not mapped): CoBank (Farm Credit bank for co-ops), Western AgCredit (Arizona Strip only), Shared Capital Cooperative (national co-op CDFI), LEAF (food, housing, worker ownership), The Working World (worker co-ops). Local co-op development: Arizona Cooperative Initiative (azcoop.coop). ◆ markers are main offices, far off-screen — zoom out to see them. Researched Sep 2026 by Marc Pierson with Claude Opus 5.5; coordinates from OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

parcels.label: ✕ Former Arizona Copper FCU — Superior branch (closed?)
parcels.notes: 161 W Main St, Superior AZ 85173. Arizona Copper FCU branch; not on American Southwest CU's branch list after the 2024-25 merger. Closure date unconfirmed.

parcels.label: American Southwest CU — Kearny branch
parcels.notes: 112 Williams Ln, Kearny AZ 85137. (520) 459-1860. Mon-Fri 9-5. Former Arizona Copper FCU home office. ~20 mi straight-line via AZ-177. Coordinate is town centre (address not in OpenStreetMap). LENDING: business notes (30-365 days), lines of credit, term loans 1-15 yr, commercial real estate; conventional mortgages incl. manufactured homes (5% down), contractor-built construction loans, HELOC. No land-only, farm or co-op programme advertised. NCUA low-income designated (exempt from the member business lending cap).

parcels.label: Pinal County FCU — Florence branch
parcels.notes: 851 N Pinal Pkwy, Florence AZ 85132. Its own site calls this the main office. ~24 mi straight-line via AZ-79. LENDING: revolving and non-revolving business lines, business vehicle and equipment term loans, commercial real estate; mortgages via NOVA Home Loans, home equity in-house. Commercial loan officer (520) 381-3100. CDFI-certified ($900K CDFI Fund award, 2024) and NCUA low-income designated — the strongest lead for a community-owned venture. No land-only, farm or co-op programme advertised.

parcels.label: Pinal County FCU — Apache Junction branch
parcels.notes: 290 S Phelps Dr, Apache Junction AZ 85120. Same lending as Florence (Pinal County FCU).

parcels.label: Desert Financial CU — Apache Junction branch
parcels.notes: 150 E Old West Hwy, Apache Junction AZ 85119 (NE corner Old West Hwy & Idaho Rd, at Fry's). ~27 mi straight-line via US-60. LENDING: SBA loans and lines, business vehicle/equipment loans, lines of credit; mortgages via its subsidiary Define Mortgage Solutions, no-down-payment first-time buyer programme. No land-only, farm or co-op programme advertised.

parcels.label: ◆ American Southwest CU — main office
parcels.notes: 3090 E Fry Blvd, Sierra Vista AZ 85635. ~150 mi from Superior.

parcels.label: ◆ Pinal County FCU — main office (per NCUA directories)
parcels.notes: 1000 E Florence Blvd, Casa Grande AZ 85122. Directories list this as HQ; the credit union's own site lists Florence first as main office.

parcels.label: 🌾 AgWest Farm Credit — Tempe branch
parcels.notes: 3003 S Fair Ln, Tempe AZ 85282. (602) 431-4100. Farm Credit is itself a lender co-op, chartered to lend to farmers, ranchers, farmer-owned co-ops, rural homebuyers and agribusiness: farm land, operating, equipment and rural home loans. Nearest Farm Credit office to Superior; AgWest also has a Yuma branch (2490 S 5th Ave). Which association covers Pinal/Gila not confirmed.

parcels.label: 🌾 USDA Farm Service Agency — Pinal County service center
parcels.notes: 520 N Camino Mercado, Casa Grande AZ 85122 (suite unconfirmed — FSA pages give both 2-F and 10). (520) 836-2048. Direct and guaranteed farm loans for land, equipment, livestock and operating costs; credit counselling. Gila County is served from Holbrook (51 W Vista Dr, Suite 3; (928) 524-3214).
